user_story: As a user, I want to assign a category to a task so that I can organize my tasks.

positive.title: Assign a valid category to a task
steps: Navigate to the task management interface
Select a task from the task list
Choose a valid category from the category dropdown
Verify the category is displayed next to the task
positive.expected_result: The selected category is successfully assigned to the task and is displayed correctly.

negative.title: Attempt to assign an invalid category to a task
steps: Navigate to the task management interface
Select a task from the task list
Choose an invalid category (not available in the dropdown)
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the category is invalid and the task category remains unchanged.

edge.title: Assign a category when no tasks are selected
steps: Navigate to the task management interface
Choose a valid category from the category dropdown
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that a task must be selected before assigning a category.
